Share your location while online

While you’re online, BiteVo Rider sends your live location to the BiteVo team, also when the screen is off or you’re in another app, so the kitchen and customers know where their order is. It stops as soon as you go offline, and Android shows a “Sharing live location” notification while it’s on.\n\nOn the next screen, allow location and keep “Precise” on.
Keep sharing in the background
So sharing keeps going even if Android closes BiteVo Rider in the background, set Location to “%s” on the next screen, then come back.\n\nYou can still go online without it.
Don’t let battery saver stop it
Some phones stop apps in the background to save battery, which would cut off your location during a delivery. Allow BiteVo Rider to run in the background on the next screen.
Turn on Location
Your phone’s Location (GPS) is off. Turn it on to go online.
Location is blocked
BiteVo Rider needs your precise location to go online. In Settings, open Permissions → Location, choose “%s” (or “Allow only while using the app”) and turn on “Use precise location”.
Allow precise location for BiteVo Rider to go online. The BiteVo team follows your live position while you work.
